Clothes
Yunli is a young girl with a fair complexion, navy and gold eyes, and grayish-navy hair cut into a bob style, with two long, low ponytails reaching her elbows with golden ornaments. She has a small golden hairpin on her right side, a large golden tiara adorned with black, green, and blue orbs, as well as another golden ornament behind her tiara, some of her hair wrapped around it in a bun. She also has an earring on her left ear resembling a peacock feather, as well as red painted nails.

Her outfit is reminiscent of those present on the Dunhuang  Murals located in the Mogao Caves ( It consists of a black and white top with thin red straps that bares her midriff adorned with a golden center ornament, a white collar lined with green, a red split cape, detached sleeves of similar colors, and a two-piece pleated skirt in both white and green with gold embellishments. She is barefoot, and also wears various accessories, including a golden plate at her hip with yellow tassels, black and gold fingerless gloves, as well as red straps on her right thigh and left anklet both with golden jewelry.

Yunli: The Cursed Blade Hunter

Born in Xianzhou Zhuming's famed Flamewheel Forge, Yunli is the prodigy granddaughter of General Huaiyan ("Flaming Heart"). Trained in both swordsmanship and forging from childhood, she became the second-youngest master of the elite Flamewheel Octet.

A traumatic encounter with a cursed sword - its malevolent energy driving wielders to madness - shaped her life's mission: to eradicate all such blades. This vow intensified after the "Flamewheel Tragedy," when warrior Hanguang fused a commissioned sword with the Heliobus cursed blade, causing catastrophic destruction. Though Huaiyan saved her, the event left deep scars.

Now roaming Xianzhou as a sword hunter, Yunli:

Studies sword techniques in everyday actions 
Carries an unfinished sword billet from the tragedy
Believes swords have spirits ("A blade is more than metal")
Driven by the hope to "free swords from their curses," Yunli continues her quest - ensuring no one suffers as she did.
